# trtrx

> Doctor-supervised testosterone replacement therapy with transparent pricing and same-day shipping. We treat men 35+ who suspect low T and want a clear, modern alternative to legacy clinics.

## What we do

- Doctor-led testosterone replacement therapy (TRT)
- Five evidence-based options: cypionate, enanthate, enclomiphene, HCG, topical cream
- FDA-approved and compounded options, both explained transparently
- At-home labs through Quest and Labcorp partners
- Telehealth physician consults (15-min video)
- Free, fast, discreet shipping
- 30-day satisfaction guarantee
- Cancel anytime, no insurance required, FSA-eligible where applicable

## Differentiators

- Honest pricing math up front (no hidden first-month upcharges)
- Unified treatment comparison grid (frequency, route, fertility-preserving, FDA vs compounded)
- Compounded vs FDA-approved explained plainly
- Branded on-domain experience (no third-party portals)
- Named medical director, board-certified physicians
